## Works Page Architecture Report

### TypeScript Files - Complete Listing

**All works-related TypeScript files (Total: 11 files, 4,885 lines)**

| File Path | Lines | Purpose |
|-----------|-------|---------|
| `/resource/ts/pages/works/scene/works.scene.ts` | 272 | Scene configuration, constants, and factory functions |
| `/resource/ts/pages/works/render/WorksSceneManager.ts` | 998 | Three.js scene rendering, card meshes, hover videos, camera motion |
| `/resource/ts/pages/works/runtime/WorksIntroRuntime.ts` | 211 | Intro playback orchestration (background & intro scenes) |
| `/resource/ts/pages/works/runtime/WorksPageRuntime.ts` | 1,464 | Main page controller - view switching, UI state, filtering |
| `/resource/ts/pages/works/theatre/WorksTheatreBridge.ts` | 436 | Theatre.js animation authoring interface |
| `/resource/ts/pages/works/theatre/WorksTheatreConfig.ts` | 96 | Theatre configuration and author mode setup |
| `/resource/ts/pages/works/theatre/WorksTheatreRuntime.ts` | 505 | Theatre playback state machine and animation sequencing |
| `/resource/ts/types/work.types.ts` | 260 | All TypeScript interfaces and type definitions |
| `/resource/ts/ui/WorkCard.ts` | 346 | Canvas texture rendering for work cards (titles, badges, video) |
| `/resource/ts/ui/WorkModal.ts` | 246 | Modal fetching and lifecycle management |
| `/resource/ts/api/getWork.ts` | 51 | API endpoints for list and modal HTML fetching |

---

### Core Class Modules & Responsibilities

#### **WorksPageRuntime** (1,464 lines) - MAIN CONTROLLER
- **Responsibilities:**
  - Page initialization and state management (`init()`, `dispose()`)
  - View switching: **scatter ↔ grid** modes
  - Category filtering with easing transitions
  - Intro playback orchestration (Theatre.js animations)
  - Wheel hint visibility (shows "Drag to explore" on wheel input)
  - Background canvas coordination (separate universe rendering)
  - Author mode detection (Theatre.js editor via `?theatre=1` query param)
  - ScrollLock integration for modals and interactions
  - URL state synchronization (query params: `view`, `category`, `page`)

- **Sub-runtimes used:**
  - `WorksGridFeedRuntime` - Infinite scroll grid with category filtering
  - `WorksSceneManager` - 3D scatter view with particle physics
  - `WorksPageUiRuntime` - DOM manipulation & aria attributes
  - `WorksBackgroundRuntime` - Separate canvas for universe background
  - `WorksIntroPlaybackRuntime` - Theatre.js intro animation player
  - `WorksTheatreBridge` - Author mode editing interface

#### **WorksSceneManager** (998 lines) - 3D SCATTER VIEW
- **Responsibilities:**
  - WebGL renderer initialization and cleanup
  - Orthographic camera with drag/momentum physics
  - Card mesh creation with canvas textures
  - **Scatter layout generation** - builds grid positions based on viewport width
  - **Category filtering** with position interpolation and opacity easing (480ms blend)
  - **Hover-to-video system** - plays video on card hover, reverts on leave
  - **Raycasting** for pointer hit detection
  - **Responsive scaling** - rebuilds scatter positions on resize
  - Pointer capture for drag interactions (supports touch with 2x velocity multiplier)

- **Sub-runtimes:**
  - `WorksHoverVideoRuntime` - Manages single active video overlay
  - `WorksViewportRuntime` - Reads DPR and FOV for responsive layout
  - `WorksHitRuntime` - Raycaster for card selection
  - `WorksCameraMotionRuntime` - Lerp-based camera + drag physics
  - `WorksMeshRuntime` - Card mesh factory
  - `WorksThumbnailRuntime` - Async batch image warming

#### **WorksGridFeedRuntime** (400+ lines of WorksPageRuntime)
- **Responsibilities:**
  - Infinite scroll detection via `IntersectionObserver` sentinel
  - Fetch works list with pagination (`offset`, `limit`)
  - Grid category filtering (mobile modal vs sidebar)
  - Video hover detection on grid items
  - DOM construction for list items with corner brackets

#### **WorkCard** (346 lines) - CANVAS TEXTURE RENDERING
- **Responsibilities:**
  - Draws work title + category badge on canvas texture
  - Handles text overflow with ellipsis
  - Aspect ratio-aware image drawing
  - Video frame capture into canvas texture
  - Texture caching by URL

#### **WorksIntroRuntime** (211 lines)
- **Responsibilities:**
  - `WorksBackgroundRuntime` - Runs main background (universe) on separate canvas
  - `WorksIntroPlaybackRuntime` - Plays Theatre.js intro sequence frame-by-frame

#### **WorksTheatreBridge** (436 lines) - AUTHOR MODE
- **Responsibilities:**
  - Theatre.js project initialization and sheet management
  - OrbitControls binding for camera manipulation
  - State capture (camera, lights, window object) during scrubbing
  - Export animation state to JSON file
  - Author control UI (sheet selector, export button, status display)

---

### Key Features & Implementation Details

#### **1. Scatter Layout Algorithm**
- **Location:** `WorksSceneManager.buildScatterPositions()` → `WorksSceneDefinition`
- Generates grid positions with alternating row offsets (zigzag pattern)
- Uses viewport aspect ratio to determine columns/rows
- Sorts positions from center outward for intro animation
- Scales based on viewport width (dynamic clamp at 1440px baseline)

#### **2. Hover-to-Video System**
- **Active only in scatter view** - plays on card hover, pauses on leave
- Uses single shared `WorksHoverVideoRuntime` instance (not per-card)
- Deactivates when switching to grid view
- Fallback: reverts to static image when video deactivates

#### **3. Filter Modal (Grid View)**
- **Location:** `WorksGridFeedRuntime._bindFilterModal()` - 100+ lines
- Creates dynamic modal with categories from blade template
- Mobile-responsive (`js-grid-filter-trigger` button)
- Updates root `data-category` attribute on selection
- Manages scroll lock via `ScrollLock.lock()`

#### **4. Infinite Scroll (Grid View)**
- **Threshold:** 280px before list bottom
- Uses `IntersectionObserver` on sentinel element
- Abort controller cancels in-flight requests on category change
- Syncs pagination visibility based on `feedState.hasMore`

#### **5. Filter Transition Easing (Scatter View)**
- **Duration:** 480ms (matches SCSS `0.3s ease` in filter button)
- **Blend effect:** Cards exiting filter move +6.5px down (fade out), entering move -7.5px up (fade in)
- Cubic easeOut interpolation: `1 - (1 - t)^3`

#### **6. Mobile/Responsive Handling**
- **TS Side:**
  - `ResponsiveRuntime.getSnapshot()` provides viewport width/height, DPR, mobile flag
  - Card scale calculated: `min(1, viewportWidth / 1440)`
  - Rebuild scatter positions on resize event
  - Camera aspect ratio updated dynamically
  - Touch pointer velocity multiplier: **2.0x** (vs 1.0x mouse)
- **Panel visibility:** Hidden on mobile, shown on desktop
- **Grid filter:** Sidebar on desktop, modal on mobile

#### **7. Intro Animation**
- **Playback:** Theatre.js animation from `json/works.json`
- **Duration:** 3000ms (configurable `WORKS_INTRO_DEFAULT_DURATION_MS`)
- **Easing:** `power3.inOut` (cubic interpolation)
- **Tracks:**
  - Camera position (x, y, z)
  - Camera target (x, y, z)
  - Camera FOV
  - Window object (position, rotation, scale)
  - Scene lights (visibility, intensity, ground light)
- **Skipped if:** WebGL unavailable, intro disabled, or author mode active

#### **8. Author Mode (Theatre.js)**
- **Activation:** `?theatre=1` query parameter
- **Editor UI:** OrbitControls for camera, sheet selector, export button
- **Auto-capture:** Samples at 30Hz while scrubbing
- **Export:** Downloads `works.json` with animation state

---

### Routes & Blade Templates

#### **Route Structure** (`routes/web.php`)
```
/works                           → works.index (scatter/grid toggle)
/works?view=grid                 → Grid view with categories
/works?view=scatter&category=xxx → Filtered scatter view
/works/list                      → API endpoint (JSON, paginated)
/works/{no}                      → Detail page view
/works/modal-component/{no}      → Modal HTML (AJAX fetch)
```

#### **Blade Templates**
| File | Lines | Purpose |
|------|-------|---------|
| `views/pages/works/index.php` | 156 | Main layout (canvas + grid dual view) |
| `views/pages/works/view.php` | 174 | Work detail page |
| `views/pages/works/modal.php` | 28 | Work modal frame (minimal) |

**Key DOM Structure (index.php):**
- Root: `[data-works-root]` with `data-view`, `data-category`, `data-page`, `data-limit`
- Scatter canvas: `#works-canvas` + `#works-background-canvas`
- Grid: `#works-grid` (hidden by default)
- Filter panel: `[data-works-filter-panel]` with `[data-works-filter-option]` buttons
- Drag hint: `[data-works-drag-hint]`
- Controls: `[data-works-canvas__bottom-controls]`

---

### TypeScript Type Definitions (`resource/ts/types/work.types.ts`)

**Core Types:**
- `WorkApiItem` - API response schema (title, thumbnails, category, paths)
- `WorkProjectItem` - Extends WorkApiItem with visual preset (bg, ac, w, h)
- `WorksPageState` - Page state (view, category, page, limit)
- `WorksViewMode` - Union: `"grid" | "scatter"`
- `WorksGridFeedState` - Pagination state (nextOffset, hasMore)
- `WorkCardSize` - Rendered card dimensions
- `WorksScatterPosition` - { x, y } layout coordinates
- `WorksPageElements` - DOM node references
- `WorksSceneManagerOptions` - Scene initialization config

### Responsive/Mobile Handling Summary

| Aspect | Implementation |
|--------|-----------------|
| **Viewport Scaling** | Dynamic card scale: `min(1, width / 1440)` |
| **Touch Support** | Pointer events with touch detection, 2x velocity |
| **DPR Clamping** | Max pixel ratio configurable, default 2 |
| **Resize Handling** | Rebuild scatter, update camera aspect on window resize |
| **Mobile Panel** | Hidden on mobile, shown on desktop via `ResponsiveRuntime` flag |
| **Grid Filter Modal** | Mobile-only overlay modal; desktop sidebar not mobile-ready |
| **Reduced Motion** | Modal close animation skipped if `reducedMotion` flag set |

### Summary: Architecture Stack

```
PageController (detects page, imports WorksPageRuntime)
    ↓
WorksPageRuntime (orchestrates all runtimes)
    ├─ WorksSceneManager (3D scatter view)
    │   ├─ WorksHoverVideoRuntime
    │   ├─ WorksCameraMotionRuntime (drag + physics)
    │   ├─ WorksThumbnailRuntime (batch image load)
    │   └─ WorkCard (canvas texture)
    ├─ WorksGridFeedRuntime (infinite scroll)
    ├─ WorksPageUiRuntime (DOM + ARIA)
    ├─ WorksBackgroundRuntime (universe canvas)
    ├─ WorksIntroPlaybackRuntime (Theatre.js)
    │   └─ WorksTheatreRuntime (singleton state machine)
    └─ WorksTheatreBridge (author mode)
        └─ OrbitControls
```

All files are production-ready, fully typed, with proper disposal chains and no inline magic numbers (all in `works.scene.ts` constants).
